reply.submission_guidance: Speak freely: enqueue requested speech now, even while playback is paused. Speech is accepted and saved for playback when the hold is released. A microphone hold resumes automatically when input is idle if configured; a manual pause waits for the listener. Report queued, not played, until Played.

Audio is being synthesized for the requesting client. Host speakers will not play it; host playback holds do not delay synthesis. Query get for segment readiness and cancel when the client is finished.
